title: 第3章 这是什么恐怖的恢复能力第4章 师兄真是太厉害了
slug: 师妹别脑补了师兄真的是凡人
content_zh:
日头西斜，将天边的云彩染成一片绚烂的橘红。
陆鸣拖着沉重的步伐，终于踏上烟霞峰熟悉的地界，忍不住长长舒了一口气。
总算到了……
感觉骨头都散架了……
回头看了一眼跟在身后的林清瑶。
见林清瑶的额角沁出了细密的汗珠，呼吸略微急促，显然这一路徒步跋涉对她而言也并不轻松。
他没有灵气，感受不到林清瑶这一路没有使用灵气。
也是心生疑惑。
修士爬山也会累吗？
还是说……我这师妹不仅天资差，体质也差？
难怪没人要她呢。
可林清瑶的眼神却异常明亮。
这一路上，她紧跟着陆鸣的脚步，感受着陆鸣呼吸的节奏，试图从中参悟那所谓的修行真意。
不过虽什么都没感受到，而且还疲惫不堪，但精神却十分亢奋。
毕竟她要去的地方可是烟霞峰！
此刻，她终于站在了烟霞峰的土地上，望着面前的阵阵云海。
林清瑶深吸一口气，感受一番天地灵气。
烟霞峰毕竟是七峰之一，灵气自然比外门富足的多。
可就在这时，她却闻到了一股让人不适的气息。
什么味？

林清瑶疑惑。
……
陆鸣累的半死，没时间管正望着远方云海怔怔出神的林清瑶。
一屁股坐在木屋前的摇椅上，陆鸣习惯性地将身体完全放松，靠进椅背。
就在此时长途跋涉积累的沉重疲惫，竟一扫而空！
并非是先感受到一股舒适之类的感觉后疲惫慢慢缓解，而是瞬间消失！
“嗯？”
陆鸣愣了愣，下意识地坐直了身体，低头看了看自己的双手，又活动了一下脖颈和腿脚。
是因为我的领域系统吗？
自从三年前得到这个系统以来，陆鸣就从未使用过系统的功能。
他一直将无敌理解为一种被动的防御或攻击能力。
却从未想过，无敌或许也意味着在领域内，他自身的状态也能始终维持在某种完美的层面？
“打开系统面板。”
【宿主】：陆鸣。
【资质】：凡人。
【血脉】：无。
【修为】：无。
【功法】：无。
content_en:
The sun was setting in the west, dyeing the clouds on the horizon a brilliant orange.
Lu Ming dragged his heavy steps and finally set foot on the familiar territory of Yanxia Peak. He couldn't help but let out a long sigh of relief.
Finally arrived...
It feels like my bones are falling apart...
He looked back at Lin Qingyao who was following behind.
Seeing beads of sweat forming on Lin Qingyao's forehead and her breathing a little quick, it was obvious that this trek was not easy for her.
He had no spiritual energy and could not feel that Lin Qingyao had not used spiritual energy along the way.
I am also confused.
Do monks get tired when they climb mountains?
Or... I, this junior sister, not only have poor talent, but also have poor physique?
No wonder no one wants her.
But Lin Qingyao's eyes were extremely bright.
Along the way, she followed Lu Ming's footsteps closely, feeling the rhythm of Lu Ming's breathing, trying to understand the so-called true meaning of practice.
However, although I felt nothing and was still exhausted, my spirit was very high.
After all, the place she is going to is Yanxia Peak!
At this moment, she finally stood on the land of Yanxia Peak, looking at the sea of ​​clouds in front of her.
Lin Qingyao took a deep breath and felt the spiritual energy of heaven and earth.
After all, Yanxia Peak is one of the seven peaks, so its spiritual energy is naturally much richer than that of the outer sect.
But at this moment, she smelled an unpleasant smell.
What does it taste like?
Lin Qingyao was confused.
…
Lu Ming was half dead from exhaustion and had no time to care about Lin Qingyao, who was looking at the sea of clouds in the distance in a daze.
Sitting down on the rocking chair in front of the wooden house, Lu Ming habitually relaxed his body completely and leaned into the back of the chair.
At this moment, the heavy fatigue accumulated from the long journey was swept away!
It’s not that you first feel a sense of comfort and then the fatigue slowly eases, but it disappears instantly!
"Huh?"
Lu Ming was stunned, then subconsciously sat up straight, looked down at his hands, and moved his neck, legs and feet.
Is it because of my domain system?
Since getting this system three years ago, Lu Ming has never used the system's functions.
He had always understood invincibility as a passive defensive or offensive ability.
But he never thought that being invincible might also mean that his own state could always be maintained at a certain level of perfection in the field?
"Open the system panel."
[Host]: Lu Ming.
[Qualification]: Mortal.
[Bloodline]: None.
[Cultivation]: None.
[Exercise method]: None.
